name: Hollow Coast
why: Shares about 41% of the Night Owls' listeners and plays the same circuit.
first_step: Plan a co-headline tour of Sydney and Melbourne.

name: The Understudies
why: A Melbourne band with a loyal following in the Owls' second city.
first_step: Offer a support slot in exchange for a Sydney support slot.

name: Enmore Underground
why: A 600-capacity room that fits their Sydney draw and books touring acts.
first_step: Send the booker their Sydney listener count and a date proposal.

name: Mara Quinn
why: Books mid-size rock shows and likes bands that bring their own crowd.
first_step: Pitch a Melbourne headline date with a clear ticket target.

name: Siren FM
why: Auckland station that plays Australian rock and has audience in their third city.
first_step: Send Neon Static with a note about a possible Auckland trip.

name: Dale Pritchard
why: Produced several records from bands at this level with strong album reviews.
first_step: Ask for a chat about the next single, with no commitment.
